summary: Comprehensive testing of RS Burger Hebrew RTL food truck app completed. Backend APIs working well (92.9% success rate), frontend Hebrew RTL layout perfect, but found critical cart state persistence and admin routing issues.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 status code when creating orders
minor_bugs.impact: Minor - orders are created successfully but wrong HTTP status

critical_bugs.issue: Cart items are added (count updates) but not persisted when navigating to cart page
critical_bugs.selector: Cart shows 'העגלה ריקה' despite items being added
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot complete orders - cart appears empty

critical_bugs.issue: Admin route (/admin) redirects to homepage instead of showing admin login

integration_issues.issue: Cannot proceed to checkout due to cart state not persisting

passed_tests: Backend API connectivity and all endpoints
Database seeding with Hebrew menu items
Business meals page navigation and display
Burger customization page with size and addon selection
Hebrew text rendering and RTL direction
action_item_for_E1: Fix critical cart state persistence issue - cart items are added but not maintained across page navigation. Also fix admin panel routing (/admin redirects to homepage). Backend is working well with only minor status code issue.
